run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T13:33:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert is explained by the ad service being unavailable. The only ad pod (ad-554b849958-p226w, ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, deployment ad) was stopped and deleted at 13:32:03, when deployment ad scaled its ReplicaSet 1→0 and then back 0→1 at 13:32:13. The replacement pod could not be created because the namespace ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (created 13:31:53, hard memory 1503238553600m ≈ 1.43Gi) is already exceeded by 1901Mi of memory requests; the ReplicaSet repeatedly logged FailedCreate 'exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi'. Since then deployment ad has 0 ready replicas, the ad Service has no endpoints, and ad's own server spans (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds) stop. A trace from 13:31:21 confirms the dependency path load-generator user_get_ads → frontend-proxy ingress → frontend GET /api/data → frontend client grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds → ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds → ad getAdsByCategory. Consistently, the frontend's error spans begin between 13:32:45 and 13:33:00 (the alert fired 13:33:05) and are confined to GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and the GetAds client span, while every other frontend operation shows zero errors; frontend-proxy returns 500 for /api/data while other API routes return 200. Frontend's pod is Running and its container Ready with 0 restarts; cart, checkout, product-catalog, payment and accounting show no error spans, so impact is confined to the ad-dependent /api/data path and its user-facing proxy layer.

claims.text: In the 12:33:05–13:49:08 window the frontend's ERROR-status spans are confined to the ad-dependent data path: span GET /api/data 491.94, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 491.94, client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 491.94 and the outer GET server span 491.94, plus tcp.connect 17.31; all other frontend operations (GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations, GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations) show 0 ERROR spans. traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans, not unique requests.

The frontend error spans start between 13:32:45 and 13:33:00: per-5-minute increase of frontend ERROR spans is 0 at every step through 13:32:05 and 35.56 at 13:33:05, and a 120s rate query is 0 through 13:32:45 with the first non-zero point at 13:33:00 for GET, GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (alert fired 13:33:05).

A trace at 13:31:21 (before the outage) shows the dependency path with all-success statuses: load-generator 'user_get_ads' → frontend-proxy 'ingress' (http 200/308) → frontend 'GET /api/data' (http 200) → frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' (http 200) → frontend client 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (rpc.grpc.status_code 0) → ad 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (rpc.grpc.status_code 0) → ad 'getAdsByCategory'.

Client spans named grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds exist only for service_name=frontend (ERROR 491.94, UNSET 1141.76) in this window, so frontend is the only caller of AdService visible in the trace metrics.

The ad service stops serving: its own server spans oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and getAdsByCategory/getRandomAds decline after 13:32 and are 0 from the 13:38:05 evaluation onward (per-5-minute increase), and over the whole window ad's only ERROR spans are 1.02 on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream.

Kubernetes events show the ad pod terminating at 13:32:03 (Pod ad-554b849958-p226w reason Killing 'Stopping container ad', ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 SuccessfulDelete) and the deployment scaling: 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' at 13:32:03 and 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1' at 13:32:13.

Pod creation for ad is rejected from 13:32:13 through at least 13:37:41 with Warning FailedCreate on ReplicaSet ad-554b849958: 'pods "ad-554b849958-..." is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'.

ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory has creationTimestamp 2026-11-15T13:31:53Z, spec/status hard memory 1503238553600m and status used memory 1901Mi — the used memory requests already exceed the hard limit, so no additional 225Mi pod can be admitted.

Deployment ad is the only deployment in otel-demo with a ReplicaFailure condition: replicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable) since 13:32:13 and ReplicaFailure=True (FailedCreate) with a message about the exceeded otel-demo-memory quota; it is generation 3, all other deployments are generation 1.

ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, container request memory 225Mi, limit 450Mi) is specReplicas 1 but statusReplicas 0, and the otel-demo pod list contains 20 pods with no ad pod at all.
The Service 'ad' in otel-demo currently has subsets null, i.e. no ready endpoints behind it.

frontend-proxy (Envoy) logs from 13:39:38 onward show user-facing failures specific to the data route: 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=... HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream ... frontend' (repeatedly), plus a few '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on /api/data, while /api/products/*, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout and /api/recommendations return 200 in the same interval.

frontend-proxy's own error spans start in the same 13:33:05 five-minute window (37.78, rising to ~320 by 13:39:05) on operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'; aggregate ERROR spans over the window are frontend 1985.09 and frontend-proxy 1010.37.

Frontend itself is running and ready at the Kubernetes object level: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is phase Running and its container 'frontend' has ready=true with restartCount 0; deployment frontend reports Available=True (MinimumReplicasAvailable) and ReplicaSet frontend-675fd7b5c5 has specReplicas 1 and statusReplicas 1.
No node shows memory pressure at query time: all 5 nodes report MemoryPressure=False / KubeletHasSufficientMemory, so a node-level memory eviction is not supported by node state.

Over the whole window the only services with ERROR spans are frontend (1985.09), frontend-proxy (1010.37), fraud-detection (2.04), recommendation (3.06) and ad (1.02); accounting and payment show 0. The fraud-detection, recommendation and ad counts are small and no evidence ties them to the /api/data path.
All 21 otel-demo deployments' ReplicaSets were created at 13:01:36–13:01:38 (namespace-wide rollout), about 31 minutes before the ad pod deletion and error onset.

Primary supported explanation: the ad service lost its only pod at 13:32:03 and cannot be recreated because the otel-demo-memory ResourceQuota (created 13:31:53, hard ≈1.43Gi) is already exceeded by 1901Mi of namespace memory requests. With no ready ad endpoints, frontend's /api/data route — whose only visible downstream gRPC call is grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds — fails, producing the frontend error rate above 0 that the RequestErrorRate alert reports, and frontend-proxy returns 500 for /api/data.

Unresolved trigger hypothesis: the ad ReplicaSet being scaled 1→0→1 at 13:32:03/13:32:13 (deployment ad generation 3) is the discrete change that removed the pod; the actor and reason (human scale action, automation, or rollout tooling) are not determinable from the available sources, and the scale action is not itself impact evidence.

An ad-internal crash/OOM is not supported by the ad objects' evidence: ad events contain no Evicted or OOMKilled reason, the pod was stopped via the API ('Killing', 'Stopping container ad') and deleted by ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (SuccessfulDelete) after the deployment scale-down, and ad's GetAds spans carried status rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with no error status while it was serving. The deleted pod's own last termination reason and logs cannot be read, so an earlier container-level failure cannot be fully excluded.

Rejected: frontend itself being unhealthy. Its pod is Running with its container Ready and 0 restarts and deployment frontend is Available; only the ad-dependent operations (GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds) have error spans while every other frontend operation has zero errors, and frontend-proxy serves /api/products, /api/cart and /api/checkout successfully in the same minutes.

Rejected as the direct cause: the namespace-wide rollout whose ReplicaSets were all created at 13:01:36–13:01:38. It preceded the ad pod deletion (13:32:03) and the first frontend error (13:32:45–13:33:00) by ~31 minutes, and all other services from that rollout show no error spans or continued 200 responses.

To restore ad, give the namespace quota headroom for the ad pod's 225Mi memory request: raise otel-demo-memory hard memory or lower other workloads' memory requests below it (currently used 1901Mi against hard 1503238553600m) so ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can create its pod; then confirm deployment ad reaches 1 ready replica and Service ad has endpoints again.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not visible in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules returned status no_data both for that rule name and for all alert-type rules, so the alert expression and the reported value 5.088888888888889 cannot be reconstructed or tied to a specific metric series.

Jaeger searches for frontend (13:34:00–13:45:00) and frontend-proxy (13:33:00–13:49:08) returned status no_data with zero spans, and the readable frontend span set ends around 13:31:21, so error-span details (gRPC error code/message) for the failing /api/data requests after 13:33 are unknown and the call chain is only confirmed for the pre-outage period.

fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 returned status no_data with 0 bytes read for 13:28–13:49, so the frontend's exact error text (e.g. connection refused vs DNS failure against ad) is unknown, and the same call reported no previous container instance, so nothing is known about any earlier frontend container.
The deleted pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its last termination reason, exit code and logs cannot be read; an earlier container-level failure of ad cannot be fully excluded.
change_history is not an integrated source in this Run, so who or what scaled the ad ReplicaSet 1→0 at 13:32:03 and who created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 13:31:53 cannot be verified.

kube-state-metrics series (kube_deployment_*, kube_pod_*, kube_resourcequota_*) and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned status no_data in this Prometheus, so Kubernetes state could only be checked as object state at query time, not as a time series across the incident window; get_label_values for rpc_method on rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count also returned no_data.
Small ERROR-span counts on fraud-detection (2.04) and recommendation (3.06) were observed but their cause is unknown and no evidence ties them to the /api/data path.

The two adopted evidence views b584e511-a55c-4022-bd78-a250ed161048-t0:0c128939-d34d-450f-a248-083de08449b9 (truncated, 60 of 246 span rows shown) and 5f0a9911-c22e-4072-9f27-f96039605707-t1:f646324b-19c9-4551-8369-08a962906707 (limit, newest 40 of 1231 matching lines shown) are partial views, so the frontend/proxy span and log pictures are incomplete beyond the rows shown.
next_steps: Use cluster audit logs (not available here) to identify what scaled the ad deployment's ReplicaSet from 1 to 0 at 13:32:03 and back to 1 at 13:32:13, and what created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 13:31:53.
After the quota is fixed, verify deployment ad reaches 1 available replica, Service ad regains endpoints, ad GetAds server spans resume, and frontend GET /api/data error spans return to zero.
Re-check Jaeger and frontend logs once retention allows and pull an error trace for GET /api/data / grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds to record the exact gRPC failure text.
